title: Alpha Crate key

replies.author: DaFrozenBlaze
replies.body: Like I explained on Skype already, you don't get awarded a key. What you got was a crate. In order to open the crate, you can buy keys at www.avicus.net/shop. More ways of getting keys will be made available in the future, but right now, this is the only way of getting keys.

CS:GO can pass with the expensive keys since you have a chance to make money in the end.
